abort.already_configured: This base station is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different base station.

error.cannot_connect: The base station did not answer. Check the address and that Home Assistant can reach the network the base station is on.
error.installer_code_too_long: The installer code has at most 8 characters.
error.invalid_device: The address answered, but not like a REHAU Nea Smart 2.0 base station.
error.no_rooms: The base station shows no rooms. Set up the rooms on the base station first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

data_description.host: Address of the base station's web interface, e.g. 192.168.0.2.
data_description.installer_code: Leave empty to skip installer data. While Home Assistant runs, installer mode stays on for every client of the base station.

reconfigure.description: Change the address or installer code of this base station.

data_description.host: Address of the base station's web interface, e.g. 192.168.0.2.
data_description.installer_code: Leave empty to skip installer data. While Home Assistant runs, installer mode stays on for every client of the base station.

user.description: The base station allows one client at a time. Stop any other tool that polls it (such as rehau-bridge) before continuing.

installer_required.message: This needs an installer code. Add one by reconfiguring the integration.

no_rooms.message: The base station shows no rooms.

not_ready.message: The base station has not been read yet.

room_unknown.message: Zone {zone} has not been read from the base station.

setpoint_unknown.message: The room's setpoints have not been read yet.

update_failed.message: Could not read the base station: {error}

weekly_program_unknown.message: This weekly program has not been read yet; give all seven days.

write_failed.message: The base station did not accept the change: {error}

wrong_device.message: A different base station answers at this address. Reconfigure the integration.

data_description.expose_calibration: Show the installer probe offsets as editable numbers. Needs an installer code.
data_description.expose_io: Poll relays, zone valve outputs and inputs every 10 seconds. The entities start disabled. Needs an installer code.

get_installer_settings.description: Returns the fields of one installer settings page with the limits the base station declares.
get_installer_settings.name: Get installer settings

get_messages.description: Returns the base station's alarm log.
get_messages.name: Get messages

get_programs.description: Returns the daily programs as periods and the weekly programs as day assignments.
get_programs.name: Get programs

set_daily_program.description: Replaces the periods of a daily program.

periods.description: List of periods with start and end on a quarter hour, e.g. [{"start": "06:00", "end": "09:00"}]. Empty clears the program.
periods.name: Periods

set_daily_program.name: Set daily program

set_installer_settings.description: Changes fields of one installer settings page. Every other field is resubmitted unchanged.

values.description: Field names and new values, e.g. {"HG1": 15.5}. Use Get installer settings for names and limits.
values.name: Values

set_installer_settings.name: Set installer settings

set_weekly_program.description: Assigns daily programs to the days of a weekly program. Days left out keep their program.
set_weekly_program.name: Set weekly program
